The host's system locale: LANG.

```hcl
step "example" {
  locale {
    name = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | Locale name, such as en_US.UTF-8 or C.UTF-8. A locale that isn't installed is generated where locale-gen exists; on the Red Hat family, add a package step for its glibc-langpack first. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_locale.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the host has this setting. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_locale` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
